data.name: Anya
data.description:
Appearance: Anya is an adult woman with black hair, fair skin and black eyes and hair, cut into a shag. Her clothing consists of the Pony Express overall, a pink, green and white turtleneck, and a pair of brown sandals with white socks. Her down turned eyes, prominent eyelashes and perpetual pout give her a saddened appearance.

Personality: Post-crash, Anya is a reserved and easily nervous woman. She has a soft-spoken demeanor and acts meek around the rest of the crew. She is prone to breakdowns, experiences anxiety, and tends to isolate herself. Curly would often be the one to reassure her before the crash occurred. Pre-crash, she seems to have been much more lively, getting along well with the rest of the crew. She seems knowledgeable about the company guidelines and rules, as she brought up the safety manual of Pony Express to find a way to reach the cargo.

She is also mentioned to have been reading a lot of books about psychology while on the Tulpar

History: Anya has tried and failed to get into Medical school eight different times and is allowed to practice as a nurse only on Pony Express grounds thanks to taking provided nursing classes. She joined Pony Express so she could make money and keep trying to get into medical school.[2] Her abilities as a nurse are often called into question.

Relationships:  Curly: 
She seems to have the best relationship with the captain. After the crash, she can't bear to give Curly his pills due to him being in visible agony. They seemed to be good acquaintances before the crash, sharing quiet moments in front of the night sky screen. She took on the role of caretaker for him, even if she did not have any experience. She wanted to be there for Curly as much as she could.

Jimmy: She often entrusts Jimmy to give Curly his pills due to her being unable to stomach seeing Curly in pain. Anya is always cautious around Jimmy. When she attempts to take his psych evaluation, he refuses to comply, giving sarcastic answers to her questions. It is indirectly stated that Jimmy raped Anya, resulting in her pregnancy. When confronted by this, he runs away from the situation. There is palpable tension between the two of them. Jimmy acts cold, sarcastic, and somewhat passive aggressive to her throughout the game. Anya compliments him and his abilities, but it is most probably a fawn response so as to appease him, as she avoids him at all cost the rest of the time; even her medical bed is away from all of the others inside the lounge, demonstrating how afraid she is to be physically close to Jimmy.

Swansea: Anya and Swansea seems to share a positive relationship, with Swansea handing her a note so that she could give it to Curly during his psychological evaluation, and Anya later on telling him about Jimmy's indirectly stated sexual assault on her. It was unclear how Swansea reacted to hearing the news, but judging from Swansea's increasing passive aggressiveness towards Jimmy after the conversation between Swansea and Anya, it can be deduced that Swansea believed her and came to despise Jimmy. Swansea also confronted Jimmy when the latter asked him what he had told Anya, saying that she “told him all sorts of things” instead, indicating that he knew what happened.

Daisuke: She is friendly with Daisuke. The two of them enjoy playing a boardgame together but can become heated during the game.
